about: Built by tools/build_fitchburg.py, traced from the Fitchburg Art Museum’s own visitor map (January 2026, scale 1:400) and kept as the museum prints it: north is down and to the right. The Simonds Building (entrance, lobby, galleries) and the Merriam Parkway Building are joined on the Second Floor by the Harris Gallery bridge. What is in each room comes from the museum’s exhibition pages, its 2025 gallery map and the FESTIVAL catalogue.
source: Fitchburg Art Museum visitor map (January 2026, fitchburgartmuseum.org/visit)
